title: Prove the linked user's access token works on AppSync, and document the token-relay exception
description:
Spike, done before anything else in M4. In development, with Ryan's linked account on Pilobolus:
- does AppSync accept the Alexa client's access token (scopes openid/email/profile) for a userPool read (`getReference`) and for `reviewReferenceCuration`?
- is `cognito:groups` present, and is `curationActorKind` recorded as human?

If the scopes are refused, add `aws.cognito.signin.user.admin` to the Alexa client (one CDK line) and say why. Then document the exception in docs/agent-rules-detail.md and docs/alexa.md: the skill relays only the end user's own token; IAM-only stays the rule for everything else. Ryan decided this on 2026-10-31.
